title: Vegan Pumpkin Spice Latte
summary: Fall mornings are a little brighter when I start them with a homemade vegan pumpkin spice latte. Made with real pumpkin puree, maple syrup, and warm pumpkin spice, this coffeehouse copycat drink is re…
ingredients: 1/2 cup strong black coffee (or 2 shots of espresso)
steps: Prepare 2 shots of espresso or 1/2 cup of strong black coffee.

In a small saucepan over medium heat whisk together the pumpkin puree, pumpkin pie spice. Stir continuously until warm, about 2 minutes. Add maple syrup and vanilla extract. Continue to stir until bubbly, and a thick syrup forms.
Add soy milk to pot. Whisk until smooth and combined.
Transfer to a blender, and blend until smooth and frothy.
Pour the espresso into your mug. Add the pumpkin spice-frothed milk. Top with whipped coconut cream (optional) and a sprinkle of pumpkin pie spice.
